missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Операция' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'прошла'. 'Успешно' adds the manner, a common phrase about surgery or missions.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Операцию' is the accusative direct object of 'сделали'. 'Сложную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Операции' is the genitive required by 'бояться', which governs the genitive. A natural way to express fear of surgery.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К операции' uses the dative 'операции' after 'к' with 'готовиться'. The phrase suits military or medical planning.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. 'Операцией' is the instrumental required by 'довольны'. 'Этой' is the agreeing feminine instrumental demonstrative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об операции' uses the prepositional 'операции' after 'об' to express the topic. 'Завтра' adds the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Во время операции' uses the genitive 'операции' to express duration. 'Свет' is the nominative subject of 'погас'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'После операции' uses the genitive 'операции' after 'после' to express time. 'Пациент' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Операции' is the nominative plural subject of 'занимают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'времени' is a genitive after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'две', the feminine noun takes the genitive singular 'операции'. 'Военные' is the nominative plural subject.
